name: eu.tykotech/tykotech-mcp
title: Multi-MCP
description: Browser control with a live view, a coding sandbox and agents over MCP

environmentVariables.name: TTK_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address. A non-loopback bind needs API keys, OAuth or a user account.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Bind port. The image's net grant names 8787; changing it means changing the CMD grant too.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: The URL clients use; seeds the Host and Origin allowlists, the OAuth audience and every link this server builds.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Host header allowlist (DNS-rebinding guard), as bare hostnames; replaces the derived list.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Browser Origin allowlist, as bare hostnames; replaces the derived list.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_API_KEYS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the JSON array of hashed API key records; watched and reloaded on change.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_API_KEYS_REF
environmentVariables.description: The API key records read once at startup from Vault (vault:<mount>/<path>#<key>) or 1Password Connect (op:<vault>/<item>#<field>).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_ADMIN_USER_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the PBKDF2 administrator record that seeds the user store on first start.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_LOGIN_TTL_S
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of a web sign-in session in seconds, 60 to 31536000 (default 604800).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_ANON_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Scopes for credential-less principals (loopback development and stdio); default the default grant.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_OAUTH_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.1 issuer URL; enables resource-server mode.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_OAUTH_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Expected aud claim; default TTK_PUBLIC_URL.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_OAUTH_JWKS_URL
environmentVariables.description: JWKS location; default discovered from the issuer's metadata.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Navigation allowlist (comma list); a host matches itself and its subdomains. Empty is unrestricted.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_ALLOWED_DOMAINS_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: What the allowlist judges in the browser: documents (default) or all requests. all needs a non-empty TTK_ALLOWED_DOMAINS.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SECRETS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the browser secrets JSON a model may type by name; values are never returned.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_MODEL_PROVIDERS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File naming the model providers the built-in agent may run text tasks on (D-143); it may hold provider keys, which are never returned.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SECRETS_REF
environmentVariables.description: The browser secrets JSON read once at startup from Vault or 1Password Connect (same forms as TTK_API_KEYS_REF).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_VAULT_ADDR
environmentVariables.description: Vault address for a vault: reference (https://, or http:// on loopback only).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_VAULT_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the Vault token; read at startup, never placed in the environment.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_VAULT_NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: Vault Enterprise namespace, sent as X-Vault-Namespace.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_OP_CONNECT_URL
environmentVariables.description: 1Password Connect address for an op: reference (https://, or http:// on loopback only).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_OP_CONNECT_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the 1Password Connect token; read at startup, never placed in the environment.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SECRET_PROVIDER_CA_FILE
environmentVariables.description: PEM bundle trusted for the secret provider connections only.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Persistent data directory: profiles, downloads, recordings, the file share, accounts and agent state.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_FFMPEG
environmentVariables.description: Path to ffmpeg; session recording needs it and TTK_DATA_DIR.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_BROWSER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Chromium executable.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_BROWSER_ARGS
environmentVariables.description: Extra Chromium switches; a switch that weakens the sandbox or runs another program refuses startup.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_CHROMIUM_NO_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: true runs Chromium without its sandbox. No shipped image sets it.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Run Chromium headless.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_MAX_SESSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Concurrent browser sessions, 1 to 128 (default 8).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SESSION_TTL_S
environmentVariables.description: Idle seconds before a session is closed, 10 to 86400 (default 1800).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SESSION_OWNERSHIP
environmentVariables.description: shared (default) or owner: in owner mode each principal reaches only its own browser sessions.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_MAX_VIEWERS
environmentVariables.description: Live-view viewers per session, 1 to 64 (default 4).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_CAST_QUALITY
environmentVariables.description: Screencast JPEG quality, 1 to 100 (default 60).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_HUMAN_HANDOFF
environmentVariables.description: true offers browser_request_human, which hands a session to a person through the live view.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_CONFIRM_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Ask a form-capable client to confirm destructive tools (default true).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SIGNED_LINKS
environmentVariables.description: true offers browser_file_link: short-lived signed download links for session files.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SIGNED_LINK_TTL_S
environmentVariables.description: Default signed-link lifetime in seconds, 10 to 3600 (default 3600).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SIGNED_LINK_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the link-signing key (at least 32 characters); required in a cluster.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_DB_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the 32-byte key that encrypts every secret in <TTK_DATA_DIR>/ttk.db (base64url or hex; setup or doctor --new-db-key writes one). Keep it off the data volume.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_MCP_APPS
environmentVariables.description: off (default), watch or control: serve the live view as an MCP Apps embed.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_MCP_APPS_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Full https:// origins of the MCP Apps hosts an embed ticket may be bound to.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_MCP_APPS_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Optional sandbox domain advertised to MCP Apps hosts.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_RATE_RPM
environmentVariables.description: Requests per minute per principal, 1 to 100000 (default 120).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_MAX_BODY_KB
environmentVariables.description: Largest request body on the REST and A2A routes, in KiB (default 256).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_MCP_STATEFUL
environmentVariables.description: Also serve 2025-era clients on a stateful mount with Mcp-Session-Id; not with TTK_CLUSTER_KV.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_OTEL_ENDPOINTS
environmentVariables.description: OTLP collector origins (comma list, max 16). While OTEL_DENO=true it must name every endpoint's origin, so empty or off-list refuses start. A malformed entry refuses start in any mode.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_METRICS
environmentVariables.description: true serves Prometheus metrics at /metrics to metrics:read or admin credentials.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: debug, info (default), warn or error.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_LOG_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: json (default) or pretty.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_CLUSTER_KV
environmentVariables.description: A Deno KV path or URL shared by every node; enables clustering.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: all (default), browser or edge; any role but all needs TTK_CLUSTER_KV.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_NODE_ID
environmentVariables.description: This node's id in a cluster (default node-<8 hex>).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_NODE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The URL other nodes use to reach this one; required for all and browser nodes in a cluster.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SANDBOX_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the coding sandbox service; enables the sandbox_* tools.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_SANDBOX_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the sandbox service's shared bearer token (at least 32 characters).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_AGENT_BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the private ACP agent runner; enables agent_prompt.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_AGENT_BRIDGE_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the agent runner's bearer token (at least 32 characters).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_AGENT_DEFAULT
environmentVariables.description: The runner's agent id to use (default default).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_AGENT_AUTH_METHOD
environmentVariables.description: ACP authentication method to select when the agent advertises it.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_AGENT_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: The MCP URL handed to the agent with its delegated token (default <TTK_PUBLIC_URL>/mcp).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_AGENT_PEERS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of A2A peers [{ id, url, token_file? }], at most 32 entries.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_A2UI_ACTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Inline JSON array of operator-defined A2UI button actions.

environmentVariables.name: TTK_AGENT_TASK_TIMEOUT_S
environmentVariables.description: How long a text or delegation task may run, 10 to 86400 seconds (default 600).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_AGENT_TASK_RETENTION_S
environmentVariables.description: How long finished agent tasks are kept, 60 to 2592000 seconds (default 86400).

environmentVariables.name: TTK_A2A_PUSH_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Hosts A2A push webhooks may target; push is offered only with a proven outbound grant for each.
